newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: SOCCER-BOOT STRIKE BY ZAMBIAN CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOOT STRIKE BY ZAMBIAN CLUB.

text.p: Players from a leading Zambian club have gone on strike after officials took away their training boots, newspaper reports said.

Twelve players from Kitwe club Power Dynamos, winners of the African Cup Winners' Cup five years ago, refused to attend training session until the boots were returned, according to the Zambia Daily Mail.
Club officials at the cash-strapped club took away the footwear with a promise to return the kit at the start of the new season in March.
But players are refusing to train with bare feet and will not return until the boots were returned, the newspaper said.
